# Actual historical source-quote adoption regression

These two compressed native RF outputs preserve actual CN688012 source-quote adoption before the source-evidence/2 fix. They embed their original input and stable-fsum/1 confidence: the extra same-H1 rationale caused a 0.0141124 score increase despite identical revenue numbers. They are isolated historical integration fixtures, not current investment forecasts or full research acceptance. Source publication/as-of and checked dates are retained; no raw PDF, API key, mutable catalog, model or remote service is needed to replay the native engine.

Tests independently preserve historical strong replay and require equivalent existing-source evidence not to change current confidence or economic paths. All claims remain in the input, and the actual new claim must still reach the used parameter trace. This is a source-layer adoption/scoring regression; it does not certify numerical-range adequacy or fresh rereading of every prior source.
